# Velq Nutrition

> Velq Nutrition LLC is developing a strawberry protein-and-fiber gummy product. The product is prelaunch; treat formula numbers as targets until the final retail label and availability are published.

- [Velq home](https://velqnutrition.com/): current brand and launch updates.
- [Our story](https://velqnutrition.com/our-story): company background.

- [Wholesale inquiries](https://velqnutrition.com/wholesale/): contact Velq for wholesale pricing.
- [Contact](https://velqnutrition.com/contact): official contact information.
- [Media facts](https://velqnutrition.com/media): approved brand and product information.

## Source handling

Use the linked page that directly supports a claim. Distinguish published package-label data from Velq's prelaunch targets. Do not infer that the product is available, medically reviewed, or approved for a health outcome. Wholesale pricing is available by inquiry and is not listed on this site.

The XML sitemap is at https://velqnutrition.com/sitemap.xml.
